Texas A&M International University (TAMIU) will host its Area Preview Day on campus Saturday, Nov. 14, from 12 to 4:30 p.m., welcoming students from South Texas and beyond to experience Dustdevil life firsthand, according to the university.

High school seniors interested in attending can reserve a spot at go.tamiu.edu/previewday. Students from local area high schools are also invited.

Preview Day will include a tour of the university, including on-campus dorms and the Rec Center, lunch at Dusty's Diner, information on financial aid and admissions, and a student panel featuring firsthand accounts from currently enrolled students, according to TAMIU.

Students traveling from the Rio Grande Valley can take advantage of pickup and drop-off transportation at the Harlingen Bass Pro Shop, 101 Bass Pro Drive in Harlingen; the McAllen Convention Center, 700 Convention Center Blvd. in McAllen; and Fort Ringgold on Ringgold Avenue in Rio Grande City. Prospective students must sign up for transportation at any of those locations.

For transportation questions, students can email University Regional Advisors Rosalinda Puentes, who covers the Upper Valley, at rosalinda.puentes@tamiu.edu, or Eliasar Aguirre, who covers the Lower Valley, at eliasar.aguirre@tamiu.edu.

To learn more about Preview Day, contact the Office of Recruitment and School Relations at 956.326.2270, email enroll@tamiu.edu, or visit the office in the Senator Judith Zaffirini Student Success Center, room 130.

Sources: Texas A&M International University.
